name: nfl-games-monorepo
description: Unified NFL Games Monorepo - All games accessible from a single deployment

scripts.build:landing: cd landing-page && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:teammates: cd nfl-teammates-game && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:trivia: cd nfl-trivia-game && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:journeyman: cd journeyman && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:dashboard: echo 'Dashboard is static HTML - no build needed'
scripts.test: npm run test:teammates && npm run test:trivia && npm run test:journeyman && npm run test:backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:builds && npm run clean:modules
scripts.clean:builds: rm -rf landing-page/build nfl-teammates-game/build nfl-trivia-game/dist journeyman/build public
scripts.clean:modules: rm -rf node_modules landing-page/node_modules nfl-teammates-game/node_modules nfl-trivia-game/node_modules journeyman/node_modules backend/node_modules
